title: Split or Steal
request: a new script for the video. Make video on this and the standard length now is 2 minutes and before you build say if this is possible to make a good video in this story
sources: Wikipedia, Golden Balls, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Balls : the show ran on ITV from 2007 to 2009; the rules of the final (both split and share, one steals and takes it all, both steal and nobody wins).

Van den Assem, Van Dolder and Thaler, Split or Steal? Cooperative Behavior When the Stakes Are Large, Management Science, 2012, https://repub.eur.nl/pub/31292/SplitorSteal_2012.pdf : 287 episodes and 574 final contestants; 52.8% of contestants chose split (about half); about 73% split with stakes up to 500 pounds (nearly three in four); a player's own promise made them about 31 percentage points more likely to split, and an opponent's promise did not make a player more likely to split; the biggest jackpot, 100,150 pounds, was won by Sarah, who stole it from Stephen, in March 2008.

Cornell University course blog, 2012, https://blogs.cornell.edu/info2040/2012/09/21/split-or-steal-an-analysis-using-game-theory : Nick announced he would steal and promised to share after the show, the host noted he had no obligation to pay, Ibrahim split, and Nick also split. Fairly sure: well documented, but no original transcript was opened.
Xataka, 2016, https://www.xataka.com/magnet/cuando-quedarte-con-6-800-libras-es-mejor-que-ganar-13-600-la-brutal-logica-del-dilema-del-prisionero/amp : the Nick and Ibrahim episode, as above.
